features: WHY CARBON FIBER - Nova Go SP1 is made of carbon fiber composite material, which means it's impervious to temperature and humidity change. Taking it on travels, to chill on a beach with the hot bright sun up above, or to a hiking trip deep in a mountain, or even further to shoot some beautiful Instagram posts in a snow land, this Nova Go SP1 carbon fiber acoustic-electric guitar would stay stable, with no warp nor cracks. It gets you reverb, delay, and fusion effects on your bare guitar, unplugged. No pedals nor amps are needed. There’s a little speaker inside the body of the guitar, which produces these effects sound, and it can be also used for music playback via Bluetooth. | A PRODUCTIVITY WORKHORSE - SP1 pickup system not only allows you to have tons of fun unplugged. You can plug it directly into your phone or PC to record any creative ideas without needing an audio interface. | SOLID BUILD & EASY TO PLAY - The body of this Nova Go SP1 carbon fiber acoustic-electric Guitarra is 1/2 sized (35 in.), molded all in one piece, meaning that the bridge is a cohesive part of the top, not glued upon like traditional acoustic guitars. It would never snap or fall off. Meanwhile, we've put a truss rod into the neck, giving your more adjustability for the string action, even though the factory setup is already optimum. Also, the Zero Fret feature is added for smoother tuning. | PRACTICAL ACCESSORIES - This Nova Go SP1 acoustic-electric carbon fiber guitar comes with a gig bag, and the packaging is colorful and delicately designed. You can send it straight as a gift to someone you love or care about. A hexagon wrench is also included for you to adjust the string action. A USB Type-C cable is there to charge the pickup system, system update, and digital output. We’ve also included an instrument cable in the package.

It's great to practice on, but not so much if you're trying to actually play in front of people. Nylons aren't meant to be used like metal stringed acoustics, they're a separate instrument! The brush mode delivers powerful sonic cleaning, while the floss mode uses a targeted water jet for deep flossing. But it's the brush + floss mode that really shines, combining both actions for a comprehensive clean. Its compact, all-in-one design saves counter space and makes your entire mouth care process more streamlined and efficient | [Powerful Brushing Modes] This sonic electric toothbrush for adults features a powerful motor that delivers up to 32,000 brush strokes per minute, gently and effectively cleaning your teeth. It offers 3 brushing modes—Soft for sensitive teeth, Clean for daily use, and Polish to brighten your smile—to suit different needs and gum sensitivities. The built-in smart two-minute timer that buzzes every 30 seconds to keep you moving the brush to all four quadrants of your mouth | [Fast Charging & Long Battery Life] Convenient fast charging base eliminates cable clutter. A single charge lasts up to 20 days, making it perfect for daily use and travel. It's also easy to assemble and use, making it great for your home and on-the-go | [IPX7 Waterproof & Travel-Friendly] With its IPX7 waterproof design, you can safely use it in the shower or over the sink—no worries about splashes. It also comes with a compact travel case that keeps everything—your power handle, extra tips, travel water hose, and charging base—organized and protected on the go. The included travel hose makes it easy to use both the water flosser and electric toothbrush, so you never have to compromise your dental routine while traveling | [Effective Plaque Removal & Gum Care] This flossing toothbrush is up to 2x more effective at removing plaque than manual brushing and flossing alone—especially in those hard-to-reach areas between teeth and below the gumline. It helps fight bad breath, prevent gum disease, and reduce the risk of cavities. With multiple water pressure settings, it’s easy to customize your cleaning experience: higher pressure levels are ideal for smokers or those who drink coffee, tea, or wine regularly, helping to target stubborn stains. For those with sensitive gums, lower pressure settings provide a gentler, more comfortable clean | [Helpful Tips for Best Results] The sleek toothbrush unit comes with a suction-base docking station that fits easily on most bathroom countertops. It's lightweight yet stable, so it stays put and won't tip over during use. For optimal results, we recommend using the water flosser first to remove debris and clean between teeth, followed by brushing. This allows the fluoride from your toothpaste to stay on your teeth longer and do its job. Brushing and flossing with water at the same time may dilute the toothpaste, reducing its effectiveness

Featuring a crisp 1920x1080 resolution, this screen delivers sharp text and vibrant colors perfect for work and entertainment. The advanced IPS technology ensures wide 178° viewing angles, so images remain consistent and clear from any position, ideal for sharing content with colleagues. Whether you are editing documents, streaming HD videos, or browsing the web, enjoy a spacious, eye-comfortable visual experience that brings your digital world to life with exceptional detail and brightness. | 【2MP Privacy Camera】Stay connected securely with the built-in 2MP HD webcam, delivering clear video for crisp conference calls and virtual meetings. Your privacy is our priority: this laptop features a dedicated physical privacy shutter (slider) directly on the camera lens. With a simple slide, you can instantly block the lens to prevent unauthorized access or hacking, giving you total peace of mind when the camera is not in use. It’s the perfect blend of high-quality communication and robust security for professionals who value their digital privacy. | 【sufficient ports to mee your needs】Connect everything you need with our comprehensive port selection. Featuring two high-speed USB 3.0 ports for rapid data transfer and a versatile USB 2.0 Type-C for modern connectivity, you can easily link peripherals. Expand your storage instantly with the built-in TF card slot, while the standard HDMI port allows seamless connection to external monitors or TVs for presentations and entertainment. Additional DC and headphone jacks ensure uninterrupted power and clear audio. This rich array of interfaces eliminates the need for dongles, perfectly satisfying all your multimedia, work, and daily connectivity demands in one slim package. | 【Built-in Cooling Fan】Experience consistent performance with the optimized internal cooling system. Designed with a dedicated high-efficiency fan, this laptop actively dissipates heat generated during intensive tasks like multitasking, video streaming, or software updates. The smart airflow design ensures the processor stays cool, preventing thermal throttling and maintaining smooth operation even under load. Whether you are working for hours or enjoying media, the quiet yet powerful fan keeps the device comfortable to touch and extends the overall lifespan of your hardware by protecting critical components from overheating. | 【Full size keyboard+Large touchpad+180 degree flat】Enhance your productivity and comfort with a user-centric design. The full-sized keyboard features spacious, well-spaced keys with a numeric keypad, ensuring a comfortable and efficient typing experience for long work sessions or data entry. Paired with an oversized touchpad, you get ample room for smooth, precise gesture controls and cursor navigation without needing an external mouse. For ultimate flexibility, the hinge supports a 180-degree lay-flat design, allowing you to easily share your screen with colleagues across the table or adjust the viewing angle to suit any environment, from crowded cafes to collaborative meetings. | 【38wh Battery+1.57KG lightweight】Stay powered and mobile with an optimized balance of endurance and portability. Equipped with a 38Wh high-capacity battery, this laptop delivers reliable all-day power for your work, study, and entertainment needs, minimizing the hassle of frequent charging. Despite its robust build, it remains incredibly lightweight at just 1.57kg, making it effortless to slip into your backpack or carry during your daily commute. Whether you are heading to a coffee shop, a classroom, or a business meeting, you get the freedom to work anywhere without being weighed down, proving that true mobility doesn't require compromising on battery life.

features: ALL-IN-ONE ELECTRIC PRESSURE COOKER: Replace multiple appliances with one 9-in-1 multi cooker. Pressure cook, slow cook, make rice, sous vide, steam, sear/sauté, make yogurt, and more—all in a space-saving design built for everyday meals. | COOK UP TO 2X FASTER*: HyperHeat technology builds pressure quickly to speed up cooking time compared to traditional methods, helping you get meals on the table faster. *Vs traditional slow cooking. | SEAR AND SAUTÉ IN ONE POT: Skip extra pans—use the large cooking surface to sear meats and sauté ingredients directly in the pot for deeper flavor and fewer dishes. | SERVE DIRECTLY FROM THE POT: The removable SimpliServe pot goes from cooker to table, making it easy to host, meal prep without transferring food, or serve meals for family dinners. | FAMILY-SIZED 6.5 QT CAPACITY: Cook for a crowd with a large-capacity pot that fits up to a 4-lb chicken or 5-lb roast, feeding 8–10 people. | FAST RICE AND GRAINS: Make white rice in as little as 8 minutes or quinoa in as little as 5 minutes*—perfect for quick weeknight meals. *Excludes time to build and release pressure. | EASY CLEANUP, PFAS-FREE NONSTICK: The removable ceramic nonstick pot is made 100% PFAS-free and designed to easily wipe clean, even after high-heat cooking. | MORE POWERFUL PERFORMANCE: Equipped with a 1200-watt heating system that delivers more powerful cooking performance compared to Instant Pot. *Vs Instant Pot Duo. | OPTIMIZED COOKING SURFACE: The wide 9.5” diameter surface gives you more room to sear, sauté, and cook evenly without overcrowding. | WHAT’S INCLUDED: 6.5-qt Removable SimpliServe Pot, 1200-Watt Powerful HyperHeat Base, Pressure Cooker Lid, and Quick Start Guide with 5+ Chef-Developed Recipes.

features: 7 Rotatable Joints: Micomlan swing arms led desk light features 7 strongly damped joints with 3 ultra bright light bars design for freely vertical adjustment and horizontal adjustment. In addition, the rechargeable keyboard is equipped with a 4000mAh large-capacity battery, which has long-lasting battery life | Hot-swap Custom Keyboard: This custom mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable base supports 3-pin or 5-pin switches replacement. Even keyboard beginners can easily DIY there own keyboards without soldering issue. F75 Pro gaming keyboards equipped with pre-lubricated stabilizers and LEOBOG reaper switches, bring smooth typing feeling and pleasant creamy mechanical sound, provide fast response for exciting game | Advanced Structure and PCB Single Key Slotting: This thocky heavy mechanical keyboard features a advanced structure, extended integrated silicone pad, and PCB single key slotting, better optimizes resilience and stability, making the hand feel softer and more elastic. Five layers of filling silencer fills the gap between the PCB, the positioning plate and the shaft,effectively counteracting the cavity noise sound of the shaft hitting the positioning plate, and providing a solid feel | 16.8 Million RGB Backlit: F75 Pro light up led keyboard features 16.8 million RGB lighting color. With 16 pre-set lighting effects to add a great atmosphere to the game. And supports 10 cool music rhythm lighting effects with driver. Lighting brightness and speed can be adjusted by the knob or the FN + key combination. You can select the single color effect as wish. And you can turn off the backlight if you do not need it | Professional Gaming Keyboard: No matter the outlook, the construction, or the function, F75 Pro mechanical keyboard is definitely a professional gaming keyboard. This 81-key 75% layout compact keyboard can save more desktop space while retaining the necessary arrow keys for gaming. Additionally, with the multi-function knob, you can easily control the backlight and Media. Keys macro programmable, you can customize the function of single key or key combination function through F75 driver to increase the probability of winning the game and improve the work efficiency. N key rollover, and supports WIN key lock to prevent accidental touches in intense games | Multi-function Control Knob: This AULA 75% wireless gaming keyboard is equipped with functional knob to switch gaming mode or office mode. In gaming mode, you can rotate the knob to adjust the brightness of the lights, and click the knob to switch the lighting effects easily; in office mode, rotate the knob to adjust the volume, and click the knob to play or pause. Long press the knob for about 5 seconds to switch modes | Side-Prined PBT Keycaps: Side-prined keycap keyboard are currently a new trend worldwide. These side-engraved PBT keycaps take double injection molding and heat sublimation process, which are more durable without fading, sweat-proof, and softer to the touch, allow the keyboard's light to shine through fonts. Compared with traditional keyboard, this side-prined keyboard can bring you a very different keyboard using experience. For the color of the keycaps, we choose gradient black color to make the whole keyboard looks cool and stylish

features: Dual-Mode Connectivity: Experience lag-free gaming via low-latency 2.4GHz RF wireless or USB-C wired modes | 12 Programmable Multi-Buttons, Engineered for Elite MMO Gamers: Dominate MMO and MOBA game titles such as World of Warcraft (WoW) with this macro mouse, featuring 6 strategically positioned side buttons and advanced customization options | Ergonomic Design for PC and Mac: A large, comfortable shape with RGB lighting as well as flexible ROG Paracord, low-friction feet for smooth glides | Hot-Swappable Switches: ROG Micro Switches offer consistent click force and a 70-million-click lifespan, while exclusive push-fit switch sockets allow you to customize click force and extend the lifespan of the mouse | High Accuracy with Instant Adjustment: The industry-leading 19,000 dpi optical sensor plus a 1000 Hz polling rate in both 2.4 GHz and USBC wired modes deliver pixel-perfect tracking. | The DPI On-The-Scroll feature lets you easily adjust the sensitivity of the wireless mouse, no software needed | Ultra-Long Battery Life with Fast Charging: Up to 67 hours of use (RGB off). A 15-minute charge provides up to 12 hours of gameplay. Rechargeable via USB-C or the included magnetic charging dock | Included Accessories: Magnetic charging dock/wireless receiver, USB-C cable, replacement switches, screwdriver, travel pouch, ROG sticker, and user manual

    "review_title": "Cheap switches you will have to replace. I wish Asus would have done better with this product.",
    "review_rating": "1",
    "review_date": "Reviewed in the United States on May 14, 2026",
    "reviewer_name": "DrBlac0",
    "verified_purchase": "Yes",
    "review_body": "Here is the deal I have with this mouse: brand new out of the box and already have double-clicking going on. Two weeks of use. While they do include a spare set of switches, this still does not account for the fact they are cheap. No wonder it's designed so one can replace switches so easily. For the price, Asus should be ASHAMED. For me, I just ordered proper switches to replace what this product came with. Not a big deal as they are dirt cheap. But still, as I stated, for a $100+ mouse, the switches should not be this cheap. This is a heavy mouse. If you use a cloth mouse pad, you are not going to like this mouse. You feel the friction and the weight of this mouse on this material. I switched to my Logitech G440 hard-covered mouse pad, and it slides like a dream. I was going to order glass skates. Glad I did not. If you install new states, you will be unable to use the dock mount. I do like the fact that there are 6 side buttons. Using a glass mouse pad or hard cover allows me to play FPS games with ease. I like the 5 DPI settings, but, again, for the price, they could have added a few more possibilities. For a few dollars more, you can have a G502 with superior hardware but a lack of side buttons. I operate in an entire Asus ecosystem; I have an Asus motherboard, PSU, AIO cooler, 5080 GPU, & 3 monitors, so I already have Armory Crate installed on my system. If you buy this mouse, you HAVE to install Armory Crate to make use of this mouse in any good way. That being said, Armory Crate is notorious for being known as bloatware. Which, in my opinion, it is. There's really no need for it to be running and eating up system resources like this app does. So buyer beware. I would have brought a Razer instead, but that mouse too requires that you install their software to work their mouse. The lesser of two evils for me was this mouse. The construction, meaning the mouse shapes and material, feels robust and tank-like. But I dare not drop it. It feels like a smartphone: it looks built for durability and day-to-day use, but one drop and it's broken. Mainly because of the weight of this mouse. It's like dropping a brick from 2'. So take care of your equipment or at least get the protection. I know this review sounds bad, but it's really not. I do enjoy this mouse; I like the fit in my hand (I have mid-size hands), I love the ring finger resting point, and the scroll wheel is smooth. My issues are stated: It should come with better switches; one needs a hard surface area to really be able to move this mouse without muscle failure, and the bloatware just to use this. It should be a $60 mouse, because in the end, you will be buying upgraded switches and looking for a mouse pad that will work well with this mouse. As far as gameplay, it does take some getting used to, but it's doable. Back in the day, gamers used to play FPS with ball mice. While this is 1000% better, a lightweight/gamer mouse would be a better pick. The 6 side buttons are the lifesaver for this mouse for me. While it takes a little time to set up profiles so they do work in the games you are playing, once it's done, you are golden. Windows does not support any more than, like, 3 or 4 side buttons, so you have to program the unsupported ones to bind to keys, then in-game, bind that key to your mouse. All in all, a good, solid mouse as long as you don't mind the 'little' headaches that come along with it. 3 stars because there are better mice out there & for a company like Asus, I would expect better from them.",

features: [Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling] With a maximum noise reduction depth of 45dB, Immerse yourself in your music without any distractions from the outside world and focus on what matters most -- your music. | [6 Microphone Call & ENC Ambient Noise Reduction] Enjoy crystal clear call quality even in noisy environments, as the earphones actively filter out background sounds. Stay connected and enjoy seamless communication wherever you go. | [Transparent Mode] Stay aware of your surrounding when needed, allowing you to hear important sounds without taking off your ear buds, making it safer for outdoor activities. | [Stereo Bass Sound] These Earbuds features built in 10mm drivers and an exclusive OrigX Acoustic 2.0 sound technology, delivering deep, rich bass and precise audio clarity, allowing you to enjoy music, movies, and calls with enhanced overall experience. | [32EQs Options & Exclusively Sharing Zone] Tailor the sound with the TOZO app further, which allows you to adjust bass levels, music style, and noise cancellation modes to your liking, and experience the joy of sharing your customized EQ with global audiophiles in EQ zone. | [IPX8 Water Resistance] Keep the headsets with an active lifestyle, they can withstand sweat, rain, and even accidental splashes, making them perfect for outdoor activities. | [Bluetooth 5.3 Technology] Simply activate the Bluetooth function with the strong signal, so there is no disconnection in listening music within 15 meters. Enjoy low latency that keeps movies and games in sync. | [Designed for Daily Use, Travel, and Remote Work] Combining long battery life, effective noise cancellation, clear calls, and comfortable fit. TOZO NC9 earbuds are designed for everyday listening, commuting, travel, workouts, and remote work scenarios. | [Comfort for All Day Wear] The NC9 headsets are ergonomically designed to fit snugly in your ears, while the choice of six sizes replacable earcaps ensures maximum comfort. Whether you’re wearing them all day at work or all night for a restful sleep, you’ll feel comfortable the entire time.

    "review_body": "My go-to earbuds have been the Powerbeats 3 for many years. I love the fullness of the sound, although the high-mids can lack some clarity.
